title: Mappingevolve: LLM-Driven Code Evolution for Technology Mapping
extraction_scope: Selected method and experimental sections, PDF Table 2 average-ratio visual crosscheck, and selected pinned driver/evaluator control flow; no experimental reproduction

conditions.validation: Compilation, ABC cec equivalence, then QoR
conditions.evaluation_suite: EPFL with ASAP7 after ABC compress2
conditions.objective: 0.5 * normalized area reduction + 0.5 * normalized delay reduction

pdf_verification.locator: Table 2, Ave. ratio row and grouped column headers
pdf_verification.method: Downloaded versioned PDF and visually inspected a local page rendering after web screenshot failed
pdf_verification.result: All six stored MappingEvolve average ratios match the PDF, including baseline normalization and area/delay/t(s) column assignment.
pdf_verification.limits: Transcription crosscheck only; averages were not recomputed from raw runs, and experimental claims are not independently verified.

artifact_inspection.scope: Read-only selected driver and evaluator control flow; no repository code executed
artifact_inspection.finding: best_state is updated on reward improvement before acceptance; rejected candidates revert to best_state rather than a separately validated state.

counterexample.fallback: candidate becomes best before rejection and is copied back as state

artifact_inspection.impact_limit: This is a source-level control-flow counterexample, not evidence that published runs followed this failure path or that any published circuit was invalid.
artifact_inspection.next_verification: Check recorded histories for this path and inspect evaluator/error handling; preserve validated state separately in any reproduction harness. Do not mutate upstream code without separate authorization.

run_history_inspection.method: Read complete selected outer log.txt files at immutable raw GitHub URLs; count Starting evolution iteration, Accepted via, and Reverting only in __main__ logger lines, excluding nested OpenEvolve events.
run_history_inspection.finding: No outer-loop reversion is logged in these three runs; each first outer candidate has zero reward and is accepted. These histories do not demonstrate the modeled first-failure fallback path.
run_history_inspection.limits: Author-released logs, not reproduced or independently authenticated executions. Nested candidate failures are not outer rejection events. No per-netlist equivalence or Table 2 source-to-result reconciliation was performed.

interpretation_limits: Composite QoR improvement is not execution speedup; area, circuit delay and mapper runtime are different metrics.
Table averages show tradeoffs, not dominance in all objectives.
Equivalence of evaluated netlists does not prove correctness of arbitrary outputs of the evolved algorithm.
Iteration parity alone does not establish equal tokens, wall-clock cost or stochastic search opportunity.
Selected average ratios are visually crosschecked against PDF Table 2; artifact/result reconciliation and independent review remain pending.
unresolved_conditions: Source-to-results traceability beyond the selected pinned control-flow inspection
Repeated seeds, dispersion and model-version details
revisit_condition: Reconcile result-producing code and per-netlist evidence with Table 2; investigate evaluator failure handling before reproduction. Revisit the inspected histories on changed evidence, not repeated unchanged-log searches.
